en: A monochrome/sepia military scene showing a line of soldiers lying prone on a grassy training field, operating belt‑fed machine guns. The troops wear early 20th‑century uniforms with distinctive spiked helmets (Pickelhaube), suggesting pre‑World War I German or Prussian forces. The background shows an earthen embankment and some simple range markers; there are no buildings or notable monuments visible. No printed text is visible on the image side.
